summary: CSW Industrials filed an 8-K reporting results of its 2026 Annual Meeting of Shareholders held August 27, 2026. Three routine proposals passed: election of six directors, advisory approval of executive compensation, and ratification of Grant Thornton LLP as independent auditor. Voting turnout was 91.4% of 16,296,266 shares outstanding. The other event noted was the retirement of director J. Kent Sweezey at the mandatory age and appointment of Darron K. Ash as Compensation Committee Chair. No special-situation transaction, tender offer, or strategic action is disclosed; this is a routine corporate governance report.
